versions.changelog:
lingxiao-selling-video 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for卖货视频方案与分镜 (selling video planning and shotlisting).
- Provides three creative directions (pain point, emotion/identity, promotion) per product to address different buyer groups.
- Offers detailed guidelines to avoid common shotlisting mistakes in AI-generated product videos.
- Includes a clear framework for writing prompts, managing shot durations, and prioritizing key scenes.
- Directs users to official tools for video generation and explains usage boundaries and responsibilities.
